india.one_line: Sarvam ships new model and speech API

themes.title: Sarvam ships new model and speech API
themes.text: Sarvam AI released an upgraded 105-billion-parameter model and a speech-to-text API covering English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute, while defending its hosting of Chinese open-weight models on privately procured GPUs.

stories.headline: Sarvam defends hosting Chinese models, releases upgraded 105B model
Sarvam AI launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian languages

themes.title: Nasscom proposes AI scheme for Budget
themes.text: Nasscom has proposed a three-year AI Services Transformation and Innovation Scheme for Budget 2027-28, to be designed jointly by MeitY and the Finance Ministry to help Indian IT firms develop and commercialise AI products.

stories.headline: Nasscom proposes three-year AI scheme for Indian IT firms in Budget 2027-28

themes.title: AI adoption reshapes Indian IT demand
themes.text: A Systematix report says growing AI adoption will sustain demand for Indian IT services firms as enterprises need help integrating and deploying AI at scale, even as automation pressures traditional labor-based delivery models.

stories.headline: Systematix report: AI adoption to sustain Indian IT services demand, labor models pressured
